sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- A.S.G.I.,C.S.C.,Neeraj Dube,Sudarshan Singh
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Donadi Ramesh,J.
1.

The instant petition has been filed praying for a writ of mandamus commanding the respondents
not to dispossess the petitioners from their house situated over Arazi No. 86, Village Kertu, Pargana
Bidauli, Tehsil Un, District Shamli, without paying compensation in accordance with law.

2. The case of the petitioners is that the respondents are threatening to dispossess the petitioners
from their holding, without following the process of law.
3.  Sri Neeraj Dubey, learned counsel appearing on behalf of N.H.A.I. has placed on record the instructions received by him.
According to it, the land of the petitioners bearing Arazi No. 86 was notified for acquisition under Section 3-D of the National Highways Act, 1956.

An award was also Ashok Kumar And Another vs Union Of India And 5 Others on 7 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/41425708/
1 made on 17.5.2021.

entities.text: Ashok Kumar And Another vs Union Of India And 5 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He submits that in case the petitioners have any grievance, they can approach the Authorities under the Act.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioners is not in a position to dispute the aforesaid factual position.

5. Since the respondents are proceeding in accordance with the procedure prescribed, therefore, no good ground is made out to issue any writ of mandamus as prayed for.
6.
The petition is disposed of with liberty to the petitioners to avail the remedies provided under the Act, if so advised.

(Donadi Ramesh, J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta, J.) Order Date :- 7.8.2023/Jaideep/-
